Extreme weather

Wildfire Emergency

Wildfire will cut your Los Angeles utility's main power connection to a tenth of its usual capacity. What can you have ready by January 2025?

Play Wildfire Emergency↗ Your decisions ↓

Choose your difficulty before you start. It’s free to play in your browser.

Location
Los Angeles, California
Starts in
2022
Your term
5 years

Your starting point

In this fictional utility, you start in 2022 with gas, solar, wind and a battery. Northern imports help cover the hours when those local sources fall short.

The scenario gives you advance warning. In January and February 2025, your existing northern connection will lose 90% of its capacity.

Learn how to play

Your decisions

  1. 01

    Measure the missing imports

    Look at the hours when you buy the most power from the north. Check what the same connection could deliver during the fire.

  2. 02

    Choose a second source

    Compare the cost and lead time of local generation with building an independent connection.

  3. 03

    Check the hours after sunset

    Batteries can store surplus solar power for the evening. Check how long they'll last before imports have to make up the difference.

Where would you get two months of replacement power?
